1a8331307d.en: A practitioner's read of the 2025 AI landscape: how industry deploys LLM-based systems, the architecture of single- and multi-agent systems (RAG, memory, tools), and the evaluations and guardrails — LLM evaluation, RAG evaluation, and LLM-as-a-Judge — needed to ship them reliably.

38b374807b.en: {1}About:{/1} An online talk surveying how LLM-based systems are built and deployed across industry, the move from single- to multi-agent architectures, and the evaluation and guardrail practices that make them trustworthy.
38b374807b.zh: {1}简介：{/1}一场线上演讲，介绍基于大语言模型的系统在行业中如何构建与部署、从单智能体到多智能体架构的转变，以及让这些系统值得信赖的评估与护栏实践。

a06328f744.en: Three threads: LLMs are everywhere in industry (personalization, service, code, security); systems are moving from single agents (RAG, memory, tools) to collaborating multi-agent frameworks; and evaluation & guardrails — LLM / RAG evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge — are now first-class.
a06328f744.zh: 三条主线：大语言模型已遍及各行业（个性化、客服、代码、安全）；系统正从单智能体（RAG、记忆、工具）走向协作式多智能体框架；评估与护栏（大语言模型评估、RAG 评估和 LLM-as-a-Judge）已成为一等公民。

5eda22b40a.en: LLM advantages: deep semantic understanding, broad threat knowledge, adaptive via fine-tuning/prompting, explanatory feedback

e7c5195ad7.zh: 示例：Zillow Fair Housing Classifier、Whatnot Rule Engine++、Google 的 Secure AI Framework (SAIF)

ebb286a058.zh: 什么是 AI 智能体

ab88e058c4.en: An LM-based entity that plans and iteratively executes tasks, taking environment inputs and triggering actions
ab88e058c4.zh: 一种基于语言模型的实体，能够规划并迭代执行任务，接收环境输入并触发行动

49f9301800.en: Composition: Brain (reasoning), Perception (I/O), Action (tool execution); capabilities: memory, tools, planning, persona
49f9301800.zh: 组成：大脑（推理）、感知（输入/输出）、行动（工具执行）；能力：记忆、工具、规划、角色设定

5b9cf198bd.en: “An AI agent cannot be just a single LLM” — reasoning limits push from single- toward multi-agent
5b9cf198bd.zh: “AI 智能体不能只是一个单独的大语言模型”——推理能力的局限推动系统从单智能体走向多智能体

4ea795b54a.en: ReAct (reason + act) — documents thought but can loop and stall
4ea795b54a.zh: ReAct（推理 + 行动）：记录思考过程，但可能陷入循环而停滞

29f4e036ff.en: Reflexion — self-reflection + verbal RL to cut hallucinations; AutoGPT+P — detector + classical planner
29f4e036ff.zh: Reflexion：自我反思 + 语言式强化学习（RL），以减少幻觉；AutoGPT+P：检测器 + 经典规划器

1b423d8995.en: LATS — Monte-Carlo Tree Search for plan / reflect / correct
1b423d8995.zh: LATS：用蒙特卡洛树搜索进行规划 / 反思 / 纠正

0dbe9d80b7.zh: 大语言模型 → +记忆/RAG → +短期规划（CoT）→ +工具 / 函数调用

b7686d0539.en: → +feedback (computer use, copilots) → +long-term planning → +self-learning → full task autonomy
b7686d0539.zh: → +反馈（computer use、copilot）→ +长期规划 → +自学习 → 完全的任务自主

c919d6cbc0.en: Single Agent: RAG and Advanced RAG
c919d6cbc0.zh: Single Agent: RAG and Advanced RAG

fd06cbe9c4.zh: {1}RAG 与 Agentic RAG{/1} · 检索增强生成

e1bda0b0a0.en: RAG reduces LLM limitations such as hallucination; workflows evolved simple → advanced → modular
e1bda0b0a0.zh: RAG 可缓解大语言模型的幻觉等局限；工作流从简单演进到进阶，再到模块化

ef0058bae9.en: Goal: adjust retrieval per task, let the LLM decide retrieval strategy, use interactive feedback, integrate multiple sources
ef0058bae9.zh: 目标：按任务调整检索，让大语言模型决定检索策略，利用交互式反馈，整合多个来源

d4fb481490.en: Relies on vector similarity, ignoring structural relationships between documents
d4fb481490.zh: 依赖向量相似度，忽略文档之间的结构关系

cb199669b8.en: Lacks global consistency; weak multi-step reasoning; fixed workflows with no behavior adjustment
cb199669b8.zh: 缺乏全局一致性；多步推理能力弱；工作流固定，无法调整行为

f827b0a3d5.en: Graph RAG: model document/entity relationships as a graph (entity ID → relation extraction → knowledge graph → optimization)
f827b0a3d5.zh: Graph RAG：将文档/实体关系建模为图（实体 ID → 关系抽取 → 知识图谱 → 优化）

93d92ea8ae.en: Agentic RAG: autonomous selection of relevant data, interactive retrieval/generation, multi-step reasoning and planning
93d92ea8ae.zh: Agentic RAG：自主选择相关数据，交互式检索/生成，多步推理与规划

4c67c8be17.en: Agentic RAG workflow — autonomous retrieval, reasoning and generation.
4c67c8be17.zh: Agentic RAG 工作流：自主检索、推理与生成。

77d938efc7.zh: Single Agent: Memory, Tools & Tool Learning

6ab250de97.zh: {1}记忆与工具{/1} · 计算接口 · 工具学习

e2ef0b83ba.en: Retrieval: short-term full content; long-term filtered by Recency / Relevance / Importance; user-editable
e2ef0b83ba.zh: 检索：短期记忆取完整内容；长期记忆按时效性 / 相关性 / 重要性筛选；用户可编辑

2ba08080a5.en: Storage: natural language, embedding vectors, triplets (ChatDB, DB-GPT); eviction when full
2ba08080a5.zh: 存储：自然语言、嵌入向量、三元组（ChatDB、DB-GPT）；存满后淘汰

0a2dba2091.en: Reflection: hierarchical summarization and self-improvement; a central agent coordinates memory
0a2dba2091.zh: 反思：分层摘要与自我改进；由一个中心智能体协调记忆

ff09332055.en: A tool is an external function: Perception (get_time), Action (web POST, file edits), Computation (code, calculator)
ff09332055.zh: 工具是一种外部函数：感知（get_time）、行动（网络 POST、文件编辑）、计算（代码、计算器）

d207b68bdb.en: Design: modular plug-in connectors, dynamic binding, security (sandboxing, permissions)
d207b68bdb.zh: 设计：模块化即插即用连接器、动态绑定、安全（沙箱、权限）

0d2091d7b8.en: Example: computer use — reads the screen, clicks, types, self-corrects across apps
0d2091d7b8.zh: 示例：computer use：读取屏幕、点击、输入，并在多个应用间自我纠错

a25a5d12af.en: Calling: ad-hoc (tool in prompt, parse) vs native function calling (interrupt → call → resume)
a25a5d12af.zh: 调用：临时方式（在提示词中给出工具并解析）与原生函数调用（中断 → 调用 → 恢复）

bc117fb9b9.en: Learning: in-context (task library, docs in prompt) vs training-time (self-supervised API learning, e.g. ToolFormer)
bc117fb9b9.zh: 学习：上下文内学习（任务库、提示词中的文档）与训练阶段学习（自监督 API 学习，如 ToolFormer）

19b2c24cc0.en: A tool library connecting agents to external tools (tool learning).
19b2c24cc0.zh: 连接智能体与外部工具的工具库（工具学习）。

1c5310be25.zh: {1}多智能体系统{/1} · 角色与应用

6ac0ac8099.en: Role differentiation: agents specialize (collection, analysis, decision) and divide complex problems
6ac0ac8099.zh: 角色分化：智能体各有专长（收集、分析、决策），共同分解复杂问题

fa8b3bf6e3.en: Collaboration gives diverse perspectives, fault tolerance (no single point of failure), scalability
fa8b3bf6e3.zh: 协作带来多样视角、容错（无单点故障）和可扩展性

c34ad3b96c.en: Single-agent limits: limited specialization, no collaboration, bottleneck, less flexibility
c34ad3b96c.zh: 单智能体的局限：专业化有限、无协作、存在瓶颈、灵活性较低

6bd15fcf35.en: Software dev (ChatDev, MetaGPT), research (Agent Laboratory), long-context (Chain of Agents)
6bd15fcf35.zh: 软件开发（ChatDev、MetaGPT）、研究（Agent Laboratory）、长上下文（Chain of Agents）

8b7a02a6b4.en: AutoGen, StrategyLLM, TradingGPT, Mora (video); healthcare & policy, embodied/robotic agents
8b7a02a6b4.zh: AutoGen、StrategyLLM、TradingGPT、Mora（视频）；医疗与政策、具身/机器人智能体

3287c8ae9d.en: Society (Generative Agents, Lyfe Agents), economy / trading (TradingGPT, AI Hedge Fund), war-gaming (WarAgent)
3287c8ae9d.zh: 社会（Generative Agents、Lyfe Agents）、经济 / 交易（TradingGPT、AI Hedge Fund）、战争推演（WarAgent）

4da964a1e1.en: Gaming (Werewolf, Avalon, Diplomacy), recommenders (AgentCF), epidemic modeling, digital twins
4da964a1e1.zh: 游戏（Werewolf、Avalon、Diplomacy）、推荐系统（AgentCF）、流行病建模、数字孪生

2c7239ac4a.zh: {1}协作与编排{/1} · 协议与结构

784e61718a.en: Cooperation: aligned objectives leverage each agent's expertise
784e61718a.zh: 合作：目标一致，充分发挥各智能体的专长

b8936c3c8f.en: Competition / adversarial: conflicting objectives drive adaptive strategies (debate, games)
b8936c3c8f.zh: 竞争 / 对抗：目标冲突，促使形成自适应策略（辩论、博弈）

943b2c40ac.en: Coopetition / mixed: a blend balancing trade-offs (negotiation)
943b2c40ac.zh: 竞合 / 混合：兼顾取舍的混合方式（谈判）

99e2f4022e.en: Rule-based: predefined rules — efficient/predictable but low adaptability
99e2f4022e.zh: 基于规则：预先定义规则，高效、可预测，但适应性低

3efe1cfa27.en: Role-based: segmented by expertise — modular/reusable but rigid if roles unclear
3efe1cfa27.zh: 基于角色：按专长划分，模块化、可复用，但角色不清时较僵化

9c54c3fd35.en: Model-based: probabilistic decisions — adaptable/robust but complex and compute-heavy
9c54c3fd35.zh: 基于模型：概率性决策，适应性强、稳健，但复杂且计算开销大

550aea5d5a.en:
Insights

  • LLMs are pervasive in industry — personalization, customer service, content, data analysis, code and security — across ~81 surveyed companies.
  • Systems are moving from single agents (RAG, memory, tools) toward collaborating multi-agent frameworks.
  • Evaluation and guardrails — LLM evaluation, RAG evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge — are now first-class engineering concerns.

Vision

  • Agentic RAG and graph RAG that reason over structured knowledge, not just vector similarity.
  • Multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) as the default way to build complex AI systems.
  • Automated, model-based evaluation (LLM-as-a-Judge) woven into the development loop.

Implications for us

  • Pick the deployment mode (local / cloud / hybrid) to match privacy, latency and scale.
  • Design agents with memory, sandboxed tools and explicit guardrails from the start.
  • Evaluate retrieval and generation separately, and treat the judge's own reliability as a risk.
550aea5d5a.zh:
洞察

  • 大语言模型已遍及各行业，包括个性化、客户服务、内容、数据分析、代码和安全，调研覆盖约 81 家公司。
  • 系统正从单智能体（RAG、记忆、工具）走向协作式多智能体框架。
  • 评估与护栏（大语言模型评估、RAG 评估和 LLM-as-a-Judge）已成为一等工程关注点。

愿景

  • Agentic RAG 和 Graph RAG 能对结构化知识进行推理，而不只依赖向量相似度。
  • 多智能体框架（LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen）成为构建复杂 AI 系统的默认方式。
  • 自动化、基于模型的评估（LLM-as-a-Judge）融入开发循环。

对我们的启示

  • 根据隐私、延迟和规模选择部署模式（本地 / 云端 / 混合）。
  • 从一开始就为智能体设计记忆、沙箱化工具和明确的护栏。
  • 分别评估检索和生成，并把评判者自身的可靠性视为风险。

f470a0bc3b.en: • “An AI agent cannot be just a single LLM” — reasoning limits push from single- toward multi-agent
f470a0bc3b.zh: • “AI 智能体不能只是一个单独的大语言模型”——推理能力的局限推动系统从单智能体走向多智能体

6d24c2dbff.en: • ReAct (reason + act) — documents thought but can loop and stall
6d24c2dbff.zh: • ReAct（推理 + 行动）：记录思考过程，但可能陷入循环而停滞

aaed568a71.en: • Reflexion — self-reflection + verbal RL to cut hallucinations; AutoGPT+P — detector + classical planner
aaed568a71.zh: • Reflexion：自我反思 + 语言式强化学习（RL），以减少幻觉；AutoGPT+P：检测器 + 经典规划器

cfdf5fa637.en: • LATS — Monte-Carlo Tree Search for plan / reflect / correct
cfdf5fa637.zh: • LATS：用蒙特卡洛树搜索进行规划 / 反思 / 纠正

3533fbf4a4.zh: • 大语言模型 → +记忆/RAG → +短期规划（CoT）→ +工具 / 函数调用

d28eb94a14.en: • → +feedback (computer use, copilots) → +long-term planning → +self-learning → full task autonomy
d28eb94a14.zh: • → +反馈（computer use、copilot）→ +长期规划 → +自学习 → 完全的任务自主

1468d1d02c.zh: 洞察 06 · 单 AI 智能体系统

1d2fa32755.zh: RAG 与 Agentic RAG · 检索增强生成

f9bebe53bd.en: • RAG reduces LLM limitations such as hallucination; workflows evolved simple → advanced → modular
f9bebe53bd.zh: • RAG 可缓解大语言模型的幻觉等局限；工作流从简单演进到进阶，再到模块化

532b762e3f.en: • Goal: adjust retrieval per task, let the LLM decide retrieval strategy, use interactive feedback, integrate multiple sources
532b762e3f.zh: • 目标：按任务调整检索，让大语言模型决定检索策略，利用交互式反馈，整合多个来源

eaf9a2c15a.en: • Relies on vector similarity, ignoring structural relationships between documents
eaf9a2c15a.zh: • 依赖向量相似度，忽略文档之间的结构关系

ba084fc80f.en: • Lacks global consistency; weak multi-step reasoning; fixed workflows with no behavior adjustment
ba084fc80f.zh: • 缺乏全局一致性；多步推理能力弱；工作流固定，无法调整行为

d789626549.en: • Graph RAG: model document/entity relationships as a graph (entity ID → relation extraction → knowledge graph → optimization)
d789626549.zh: • Graph RAG：将文档/实体关系建模为图（实体 ID → 关系抽取 → 知识图谱 → 优化）

a4b8156931.en: • Agentic RAG: autonomous selection of relevant data, interactive retrieval/generation, multi-step reasoning and planning
a4b8156931.zh: • 智能体式 RAG：自主选择相关数据、交互式检索/生成、多步推理与规划

7330629c23.zh: 洞察 07 · 单智能体系统

300cbe5d9d.en: Memory & tools · compute interface · tool learning
300cbe5d9d.zh: 记忆与工具 · 计算接口 · 工具学习

f25c70db8d.en: • Retrieval: short-term full content; long-term filtered by Recency / Relevance / Importance; user-editable
f25c70db8d.zh: • 检索：短期记忆取完整内容；长期记忆按时近性 / 相关性 / 重要性过滤；用户可编辑

9c3f0c201f.en: • Storage: natural language, embedding vectors, triplets (ChatDB, DB-GPT); eviction when full
9c3f0c201f.zh: • 存储：自然语言、嵌入向量、三元组（ChatDB、DB-GPT）；存满后淘汰旧内容

2a79b9beeb.en: • Reflection: hierarchical summarization and self-improvement; a central agent coordinates memory
2a79b9beeb.zh: • 反思：分层摘要与自我改进；由一个中央智能体协调记忆

fd7eaeb55c.en: • A tool is an external function: Perception (get_time), Action (web POST, file edits), Computation (code, calculator)
fd7eaeb55c.zh: • 工具是一个外部函数：感知（get_time）、行动（web POST、文件编辑）、计算（代码、计算器）

e8fcc91fa8.en: • Design: modular plug-in connectors, dynamic binding, security (sandboxing, permissions)
e8fcc91fa8.zh: • 设计：模块化插件式连接器、动态绑定、安全（沙箱、权限）

ee576cb920.en: • Example: computer use — reads the screen, clicks, types, self-corrects across apps
ee576cb920.zh: • 示例：计算机使用 — 读取屏幕、点击、输入，并跨应用自我纠错

cab2206373.en: • Calling: ad-hoc (tool in prompt, parse) vs native function calling (interrupt → call → resume)
cab2206373.zh: • 调用：临时方式（工具写入提示词，再解析）与原生函数调用（中断 → 调用 → 恢复）

8ae54c648b.en: • Learning: in-context (task library, docs in prompt) vs training-time (self-supervised API learning, e.g. ToolFormer)
8ae54c648b.zh: • 学习：上下文内学习（任务库、提示词中的文档）与训练期学习（自监督 API 学习，如 ToolFormer）

8e9b784310.zh: 洞察 08 · 多智能体系统

36fb8fda0e.zh: 多智能体系统 · 角色与应用

efc04b098c.en: • Role differentiation: agents specialize (collection, analysis, decision) and divide complex problems
efc04b098c.zh: • 角色分化：智能体各有专长（收集、分析、决策），共同拆解复杂问题

9037998337.en: • Collaboration gives diverse perspectives, fault tolerance (no single point of failure), scalability
9037998337.zh: • 协作带来多样视角、容错能力（无单点故障）和可扩展性

a5dc5dc91f.en: • Single-agent limits: limited specialization, no collaboration, bottleneck, less flexibility
a5dc5dc91f.zh: • 单智能体的局限：专业化有限、无法协作、存在瓶颈、灵活性较低

dd49526b35.en: • Software dev (ChatDev, MetaGPT), research (Agent Laboratory), long-context (Chain of Agents)
dd49526b35.zh: • 软件开发（ChatDev、MetaGPT）、研究（Agent Laboratory）、长上下文（Chain of Agents）

2f0e64de9a.en: • AutoGen, StrategyLLM, TradingGPT, Mora (video); healthcare & policy, embodied/robotic agents
2f0e64de9a.zh: • AutoGen、StrategyLLM、TradingGPT、Mora（视频）；医疗与政策、具身/机器人智能体

6a8b3e614a.en: • Society (Generative Agents, Lyfe Agents), economy / trading (TradingGPT, AI Hedge Fund), war-gaming (WarAgent)
6a8b3e614a.zh: • 社会（Generative Agents、Lyfe Agents）、经济 / 交易（TradingGPT、AI Hedge Fund）、战争推演（WarAgent）

27c674c276.en: • Gaming (Werewolf, Avalon, Diplomacy), recommenders (AgentCF), epidemic modeling, digital twins
27c674c276.zh: • 游戏（Werewolf、Avalon、Diplomacy）、推荐系统（AgentCF）、疫情建模、数字孪生

ef4f646589.zh: 洞察 09 · 多智能体系统

ca9767af43.zh: 协作与编排 · 协议与结构

83c80c06c3.en: • Cooperation: aligned objectives leverage each agent's expertise
83c80c06c3.zh: • 合作：目标一致，发挥每个智能体的专长

bc59e563ae.en: • Competition / adversarial: conflicting objectives drive adaptive strategies (debate, games)
bc59e563ae.zh: • 竞争 / 对抗：目标冲突，推动自适应策略（辩论、博弈）

b4db8a5585.en: • Coopetition / mixed: a blend balancing trade-offs (negotiation)
b4db8a5585.zh: • 竞合 / 混合：兼顾取舍的混合形式（谈判）

2ad9ee8970.en: • Rule-based: predefined rules — efficient/predictable but low adaptability
2ad9ee8970.zh: • 基于规则：预定义规则 — 高效、可预测，但适应性低

043c4a42f9.en: • Role-based: segmented by expertise — modular/reusable but rigid if roles unclear
043c4a42f9.zh: • 基于角色：按专长划分 — 模块化、可复用，但角色不清时较僵化

aa0f529813.en: • Model-based: probabilistic decisions — adaptable/robust but complex and compute-heavy
aa0f529813.zh: • 基于模型：概率式决策 — 适应性强、稳健，但复杂且计算开销大

acd5563a3e.en: • Centralized (simple/efficient, but central failure collapses the system)
acd5563a3e.zh: • 集中式（简单高效，但中心故障会使系统崩溃）

0b03deebe7.en: • Decentralized/distributed (resilient, scalable: swarm, MetaGPT, ChatDev) and hierarchical (DyLAN)
0b03deebe7.zh: • 去中心化/分布式（有韧性、可扩展：swarm、MetaGPT、ChatDev）与分层式（DyLAN）

5a86cf021d.en: • Static vs dynamic channels: predefined domain channels vs real-time adaptive management
5a86cf021d.zh: • 静态与动态通道：预定义的领域通道与实时自适应管理

c867bd6e46.zh: 洞察 10 · 多智能体系统

564472e6b6.zh: LangGraph · CrewAI · AutoGen · 智能体框架

47a1643148.en: • Tools for agent-to-agent communication, orchestration, workflow management, tool use and decision-making
47a1643148.zh: • 提供智能体间通信、编排、工作流管理、工具使用和决策的工具

fe2282b74a.en: • Enable low/no-code application building; most popular: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen
fe2282b74a.zh: • 支持低代码/无代码构建应用；最流行的有 LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen

ee3886b83c.en: • LangGraph: graph-organized (agents = nodes, steps = edges), shared typed State, state persistence for recovery
ee3886b83c.zh: • LangGraph：以图组织（智能体 = 节点，步骤 = 边），共享的带类型状态，状态持久化以便恢复

47631d668b.en: • CrewAI: Agents + Tasks grouped in a Crew; a 'flow' coordinates workflows with a manager pattern
47631d668b.zh: • CrewAI：智能体 + 任务组成一个 Crew；用“flow”以管理者模式协调工作流

8d52fd32f9.en: • Layered: Core API (message passing, runtime), Agent Chat (prototyping), Extensions (LLM clients, RAG tools)
8d52fd32f9.zh: • 分层：Core API（消息传递、运行时）、Agent Chat（原型开发）、Extensions（大语言模型客户端、RAG 工具）

83dd453600.en: • Async message workflow; single or distributed runtime; serializable messages, direct-send or topic broadcast
83dd453600.zh: • 异步消息工作流；单机或分布式运行时；可序列化消息，直接发送或按主题广播

0f64ed4361.zh: 大语言模型评估 · 标准、指标与框架

6a0134f16e.en: • Accuracy (vs gold/expert), Ethicality (privacy, misinformation, fairness, transparency), Fairness (bias mitigation)
6a0134f16e.zh: • 准确性（对照金标准/专家）、伦理性（隐私、虚假信息、公平、透明）、公平性（缓解偏见）

1c0ef2ffc2.en: • Generalization (unseen data), Robustness (adversarial resilience), Reasoning (logical / causal inference)
1c0ef2ffc2.zh: • 泛化性（未见数据）、鲁棒性（对抗韧性）、推理（逻辑 / 因果推断）

dc72577906.en: • Classification: Accuracy, Recall, Precision, F1, Micro/Macro-F1

5ac824c54d.en: • Token-similarity: Perplexity, BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore; QA: strict/lenient accuracy, MRR
5ac824c54d.zh: • Token 相似度：Perplexity、BLEU、ROUGE、BERTScore；问答：严格/宽松准确率、MRR

c1989b49e8.en: • Evidently AI: text stats/patterns, model-based evals (semantic similarity, toxicity, BERTScore)
c1989b49e8.zh: • Evidently AI：文本统计/模式，基于模型的评估（语义相似度、毒性、BERTScore）

cb6ead089a.en: • Aporia: restricted phrases, prompt-injection DB, Text-to-SQL security, DoS / cost / RAG access control
cb6ead089a.zh: • Aporia：受限短语、提示词注入数据库、Text-to-SQL 安全、DoS / 成本 / RAG 访问控制

21fbea6a65.en: • Ragas: string similarity, context precision/recall, noise sensitivity, topic adherence
21fbea6a65.zh: • Ragas：字符串相似度、上下文精确率/召回率、噪声敏感度、主题遵循度

e9195c1b59.zh: RAG 评估 · 目标、指标与基准测试

decfd1ab33.en: • Traditional-RAG problems: retrieval errors (irrelevant docs, fixed retrieval) and hallucination despite relevant data
decfd1ab33.zh: • 传统 RAG 的问题：检索错误（文档不相关、检索方式固定），以及即使数据相关仍产生幻觉

73c5ba56bd.en: • Pre-generation judges retrieval quality; post-generation validates output against retrieved docs
73c5ba56bd.zh: • 生成前评判检索质量；生成后对照检索到的文档验证输出

1934106189.en: • Retrieval quality (context relevance) and generation quality (faithfulness, answer relevance)
1934106189.zh: • 检索质量（上下文相关性）和生成质量（忠实度、答案相关性）

60475097a6.en: • Also noise robustness, negative rejection, information integration, counterfactual robustness
60475097a6.zh: • 还包括噪声鲁棒性、负例拒答、信息整合、反事实鲁棒性

2ea8762ad4.en: • Metrics: Exact Match, Recall/Precision, Cosine Similarity, Hit Rate, MRR, NDCG, BLEU, ROUGE-L

7fda1ce6d8.en: • LLMs judge candidate outputs; reliability concern shifts to the judge itself
7fda1ce6d8.zh: • 由大语言模型评判候选输出；可靠性问题转移到评判者本身

3c6b48c54b.en: • Input: point-wise vs pair/list-wise; output: score-, ranking-, or selection-based (rubric or pairwise)
3c6b48c54b.zh: • 输入：逐点与成对/列表式；输出：基于打分、排序或选择（评分标准或成对比较）

391e18a592.en: • Model tuning: manual vs synthetic feedback; supervised fine-tuning, preference / meta-rewarding
391e18a592.zh: • 模型调优：人工反馈与合成反馈；监督微调、偏好 / 元奖励

0aa4f2d43c.en: • Prompting: position-bias swapping, multi-agent (peer rank, debate, voting), rule augmentation, multi-turn
0aa4f2d43c.zh: • 提示：位置偏差交换、多智能体（同伴排名、辩论、投票）、规则增强、多轮

77744723ff.en: • Mitigate positional bias with order-swapping and highest-log-probability selection
77744723ff.zh: • 用顺序交换和选择最高对数概率来缓解位置偏差

9d884cdb2e.en: • Attributes: helpfulness, harmlessness, reliability (HALU-J), relevance, feasibility, quality
9d884cdb2e.zh: • 属性：有用性、无害性、可靠性（HALU-J）、相关性、可行性、质量

fb9ab6a6ec.en: • Uses: reasoning-path selection (CoT, debate, Tree-of-Thoughts), retrieval ranking, self-judging
fb9ab6a6ec.zh: • 用途：推理路径选择（CoT、辩论、Tree-of-Thoughts）、检索排序、自我评判

1b79f0df2f.en: • Frameworks: Evidently AI, Aporia, Ragas; worked examples CRAG (self-corrective RAG) and SELF-RAG (self-reflective RAG)
1b79f0df2f.zh: • 框架：Evidently AI、Aporia、Ragas；实例有 CRAG（自纠正 RAG）和 SELF-RAG（自反思 RAG）

6ad33e87a4.en: • LLMs are pervasive in industry — personalization, customer service, content, data analysis, code and security — across ~81 surveyed companies.
6ad33e87a4.zh: • 大语言模型在行业中无处不在 — 个性化、客户服务、内容、数据分析、代码和安全 — 覆盖约 81 家受访公司。

2fc2888a08.en: • Systems are moving from single agents (RAG, memory, tools) toward collaborating multi-agent frameworks.
2fc2888a08.zh: • 系统正从单智能体（RAG、记忆、工具）转向相互协作的多智能体框架。

05a37f70d0.en: • Evaluation and guardrails — LLM evaluation, RAG evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge — are now first-class engineering concerns.
05a37f70d0.zh: • 评估与护栏 — 大语言模型评估、RAG 评估和 LLM-as-a-Judge — 已成为一等工程关注点。

1114da2873.en: • Agentic RAG and graph RAG that reason over structured knowledge, not just vector similarity.
1114da2873.zh: • 智能体式 RAG 和图 RAG，对结构化知识进行推理，而不只是向量相似度。

66df802dec.en: • Multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) as the default way to build complex AI systems.
66df802dec.zh: • 多智能体框架（LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen）成为构建复杂 AI 系统的默认方式。

d31525fbe2.en: • Automated, model-based evaluation (LLM-as-a-Judge) woven into the development loop.
d31525fbe2.zh: • 自动化的、基于模型的评估（LLM-as-a-Judge）融入开发循环。

805643e09d.en: • Pick the deployment mode (local / cloud / hybrid) to match privacy, latency and scale.
805643e09d.zh: • 根据隐私、延迟和规模选择部署模式（本地 / 云端 / 混合）。

64c6265988.en: • Design agents with memory, sandboxed tools and explicit guardrails from the start.
64c6265988.zh: • 从一开始就为智能体设计记忆、沙箱化工具和明确的护栏。

50ba69697b.en: • Evaluate retrieval and generation separately, and treat the judge's own reliability as a risk.
50ba69697b.zh: • 分别评估检索和生成，并把评判者自身的可靠性视为风险。
